decided_by.quote: Assessments must be assigned to one of the following AI categories, and this must be communicated to students and stated on assessment briefs, including on the Course Unit Canvas assessment information.
The assessment information must set out what is acceptable AI use.

For assessed group work, the course unit lead must state the category of the assessment and provide clear information to students about how to approach AI use as a group before beginning the activity.

duty.quote: Within assessed work, students’ failure to document use of Generative AI could be a form of plagiarism contrary to the Academic Malpractice Procedure.
